notes.title: On November 7th, succeeded in hiding Jack's heart.
notes.content:
[h2][b]I heard that a brave adventurer found Jack's heart!
We are looking forward to hearing from him.
Sooner or later, I'll tell you a story about what we've prepared. Thank you.
[/b][/h2]

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Hello.

I'm so happy to finish this project, which started in 2018.
It's a game I made for my daughter, but I grew up a lot by making SOWON.
I hid Jack's heart to finish the painting. 
It's the final puzzle of the game, and it's too difficult.
If at least one person does it, I think we can remember it as a great story


Thank you.

notes.title: Find Jack's heart
notes.content:
I heard that a brave adventurer found Jack's heart!
We are looking forward to hearing from him.
Sooner or later, I'll tell you a story about what we've prepared. Thank you.


------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We are on November 7th
I've decided to bury Jack's heart
Only one person who solved the secret hidden in the game can find Jack's heart

I want you to be the main character
